patches.title: Start at Countertop
patches.principle: Begin your search by going to the countertop, as it is the most common open surface with target objects.
patches.when_to_apply: At the start of a task before exploring containers.

patches.title: Avoid Re-Opening Containers
patches.principle: If you have already opened a container and seen its contents, do not open it again. Move on to the next.
patches.when_to_apply: When you encounter a previously opened container.

patches.title: No Detours After Pickup
patches.principle: After picking up the target object, do not wander; go straight to the transformation appliance or destination.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have just picked up an object that needs cleaning, cooling, or heating.
